features.blog.page.list.title: Blog
features.blog.page.new.title: New post
features.blog.page.detail.title: Post
features.blog.created: Draft “{name}” created. It is not on the storefront until you publish it.
features.blog.list.intro: Posts of the shop's blog. A draft and a scheduled post are not on the storefront; a published post is, in every language it is written in.
features.blog.list.caption: Blog posts, the most recently changed first
features.blog.list.emptyBody: Write the first post: it stays a draft until you publish it.
features.blog.form.publicNote: Published posts are public. Never write personal data (names of customers, addresses, phone numbers) into a post.
features.blog.form.slugHintCreate: The end of the post's address: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Leave it empty to make one from the title.
features.blog.form.slugHint: The end of the post's address: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It is fixed once the post is published.
features.blog.form.slugLocked: Fixed: the post has a publish date, and links to it must keep working.
features.blog.form.title: Title ({language})
features.blog.form.titleHint: The heading of the post. Needed in every language to publish.
features.blog.form.titleRequired: Enter the title in the main language.
features.blog.form.excerptHint: Shown in the list of posts.
features.blog.form.bodyHint: Markdown, see “Text formatting”. Needed in every language to publish. Mistakes are shown with their line when you save.
features.blog.form.seoTitleHint: Optional; the title is used without it.
features.blog.form.seoDescriptionHint: Optional; the summary is used without it.
features.blog.form.coverAltHint: What the cover shows, for people who cannot see it. Empty: the cover is decorative.
features.blog.syntax.title: Text formatting
features.blog.syntax.headings: ## Heading, ### Subheading, #### Small heading (the post's title is the page's only top heading).
features.blog.syntax.lists: Lists: lines that start with “- ” or “1. ”.
features.blog.syntax.links: Links: [text](/catalog) for a page of the shop, written without the language, or [text](https://example.com).
features.blog.syntax.code: Code: lines between two lines of ```.
features.blog.syntax.notAllowed: No HTML and no pictures inside the text: the cover is the post's picture.
features.blog.cover.heading: Cover
features.blog.cover.limits: Allowed: {types}; at most {max} MB. A picture you do not save is deleted from the server after 24 hours.
features.blog.cover.uploadsOffBody: This shop does not accept image uploads, so a new cover cannot be added. A cover can still be removed.
features.blog.publish.heading: Publishing
features.blog.publish.isDraftWithDate: Draft: not on the storefront. Its publish date stays {date}.
features.blog.publish.saveFirst: Save your changes first: publishing uses the saved post.
features.blog.publish.when.label: Date and time
features.blog.publish.when.hint: In your time zone ({zone}). A time in the future schedules the post; a past time publishes it now with that date.
features.blog.publish.when.required: Choose a date and a time.
features.blog.publish.when.invalid: This is not a date and time.
features.blog.publish.when.outOfRange: Choose a date from the year 2000 to 2199.
features.blog.publish.done.unpublished: The post is a draft again and no longer on the storefront.
features.blog.delete.info: Deleting removes the post from the admin and the storefront for good. Its cover picture stays in the media storage.
features.blog.delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
features.blog.delete.body: The post cannot be restored, and links to it stop working.
features.blog.delete.hint: Reload the page and try again.
features.blog.reason.invalid_slug: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens (my-first-post).
features.blog.reason.empty_slug: No address can be made from this title: enter the address yourself.
features.blog.reason.slug_taken: Another post already uses this address.
features.blog.reason.slug_locked: The address is fixed once the post has a publish date.
features.blog.reason.translation_incompl: To publish, the post needs a title and a text in every language:
features.blog.reason.translation_missing: This text is needed in every language to publish.
features.blog.reason.markdown_too_long: The text is longer than 40 000 characters.
features.blog.markdown.control_character: Line {line}: the text contains an invisible control character. Remove it.
features.blog.markdown.heading_level: Line {line}: headings use ## to #### (# is the post's title; ##### and deeper are not allowed).
features.blog.markdown.empty_heading: Line {line}: a heading has no text.
features.blog.markdown.unclosed_code_fen: Line {line}: a code block (```) is never closed.
features.blog.markdown.link_refused: Line {line}: this link is not allowed.
features.blog.markdown.empty_link_text: Line {line}: a link needs visible text: [text](address).
features.blog.markdown.too_long: Line {line}: the text is longer than 40 000 characters.
features.blog.markdown.too_many_blocks: Line {line}: the text has too many paragraphs, headings and list items.
features.blog.markdown.too_deep: Line {line}: lists, quotes or emphasis are nested too deeply.
features.blog.markdown.too_many_links: Line {line}: the text has too many links.
features.blog.markdown.too_many_nodes: Line {line}: the text has too many formatted parts.
features.blog.markdown.too_large: Line {line}: the formatted text is too large. Make it shorter.
features.blog.markdown.unknown: Line {line}: this text cannot be saved.
features.blog.markdown.link.empty: Line {line}: a link has no address.
features.blog.markdown.link.too_long: Line {line}: a link address is too long.
features.blog.markdown.link.invalid_char: Line {line}: a link address contains a space, a control character or a backslash.
features.blog.markdown.link.not_path_or_: Line {line}: a link must be a page of the shop (/catalog) or an https:// address.
features.blog.markdown.link.protocol_rel: Line {line}: an address that starts with // leads to another site; write https:// in full.
features.blog.markdown.link.dot_segment: Line {line}: a link address may not contain . or .. parts.
features.blog.markdown.link.locale_prefi: Line {line}: write a shop link without the language (/catalog, not /uk/catalog); the shop adds it.
features.blog.markdown.link.credentials: Line {line}: a link address may not contain a user name or a password.
features.blog.markdown.link.control_char: Line {line}: a link address contains an invisible control character.
features.blog.markdown.link.bidi_control: Line {line}: a link address contains a text direction character.
features.blog.markdown.link.format_chara: Line {line}: a link address contains an invisible formatting character.
